# data.docker_task_logs

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads a snapshot of one swarm task's logs (`GET /tasks/{id}/logs`), like `docker service logs <task id>`. `log_entries` has one object per line (`timestamp`, `stream`, `source` = the task ID, `message`, which alone is sensitive) and `logs` the same as text. `tail` (default 1000) and `since` bound what is read; the provider's host must be a swarm manager.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of logs. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version of the daemon the provider talked to (GET /version Version). |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version the provider negotiated with the daemon (GET /version ApiVersion, capped by the client's max). |
| `id` | `string` | computed |  |  | Full ID the logs were read from. |
| `log_entries` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | One entry per log line in arrival order, read with timestamps=true and bounded by the tail/since inputs; `source` is the task ID. Only `message` is sensitive (log lines can print secrets). |
| `logs` | `string` | computed |  | yes | The log entries as plain text, one line per entry: "<timestamp> <stream> <source> <message>". Sensitive: log lines can print secrets. |
| `since` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only lines at or after this time. Takes an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. `2026-01-02T15:04:05Z`) or a duration before now such as `42m` or `1h30m`, sent as the Engine's UNIX-timestamp `since`. Combined with `tail` when both are set. |
| `tail` | `number` | optional |  |  | Lines to keep from the end of the logs of each container, service or task (the Engine's `tail`). Default `1000`, so state cannot grow without bound; `0` reads none, and there is no "all". |
| `task_id` | `string` | required |  |  | Task ID (see `docker_tasks`). |

### `log_entries`

nested attribute, list(object). One entry per log line in arrival order, read with timestamps=true and bounded by the tail/since inputs; `source` is the task ID. Only `message` is sensitive (log lines can print secrets).

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | `string` | computed |  | yes | Upstream `log line without the timestamp prefix and trailing newline`. Sensitive. |
| `source` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `ID`. |
| `stream` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `multiplexed frame header stream type: 1 = stdout, 2 = stderr; a TTY stream is not multiplexed (the Engine merges stdout and stderr at the source), so it is "combined"`. |
| `timestamp` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `timestamps=true line prefix (RFC 3339 nano)`. |

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_tasks" "web" {
  service_id = "web"
}

data "docker_task_logs" "first" {
  task_id = data.docker_tasks.web.ids[0]
  tail    = 50
}

output "first_task_logs" {
  value     = data.docker_task_logs.first.logs
  sensitive = true
}
```
